assets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and blue-green RAZE outfits wear pumps and bright rainbow knee-highs on Galway's Long Walk as the two women at right share a kiss.

Four fictional adult women in short copper-silver, pink, turquoise-ivory, and plum RAZE looks wear pumps and colorful thigh-high hosiery on a Killarney lake terrace while the blonde woman kisses her neighbor's cheek.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze, blue-copper, black-magenta, and teal RAZE looks wear dramatic metallic knee-high boots on the Cliffs of Moher viewing platform as the two women at right lean together affectionately.

Four fictional adult women in short copper-blue, lilac, red-ivory, and emerald RAZE looks wear gradient rainbow thigh-high stockings and stilettos on the Vaduz Kunstmuseum plaza with the dark museum cube and Alpine peaks behind them.

caption: Ireland ❤️ Liechtenstein: Galway's waterfront, Killarney's lakes and the Cliffs of Moher meet Vaduz. Warm kisses and side hugs, metallic mini couture, rainbow stockings and star-heel boots. Four fictional adult friends in AI fashion.
